mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner ear's sensing tissue was most worthwhile: the result showed how moving fluid bends tiny hairs and changes nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the hearing pathways and then attaching the ears to the body felt a little repetitive, since both results showed a connection toward the brain.

surprise.text: I hadn't known that tiny hairs in the inner ear bend with fluid movement to change signals to nerves.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. I guessed that the hearing cells belonged with the fluid-filled chambers, and the result explained their role.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter offered a similarly clear route from a familiar experience to how the body works. The hearing pathway was interesting to put together, though the final connections were predictable.
